# Vendored brand sources

These SVG files fill gaps in the upstream brand catalogs used by the generator. They are kept as build inputs and are not copied into the published package except as optimized runtime assets.

| File                                    | Source                                                                              | Copyright status stated by source                          |
| --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `byd.svg`                               | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BYD_Auto_2022_logo.svg) | Public-domain simple logo geometry; trademarked            |
| `cruise.svg`                            | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cruise_logo.svg)        | Public-domain text and simple geometry; trademarked        |
| `crowdstrike.svg`                       | [CrowdStrike brand assets](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/about-us/brand/)       | Official Falcon mark; trademark guidelines apply           |
| `crowdstrike-wordmark.svg`              | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:CrowdStrike_logo.svg)   | Public-domain text and simple geometry; trademarked        |
| `fortinet.svg`, `fortinet-wordmark.svg` | [Fortinet Icon Library](https://icons.fortinet.com/)                                | Official logomark and wordmark; trademark guidelines apply |
| `mobileye.svg`                          | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mobileye_logo.svg)      | Public-domain simple geometry; trademarked                 |
| `nio.svg`                               | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NIO_logo_emblem.svg)    | Public-domain simple geometry; trademarked                 |
| `rivian.svg`                            | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rivian_logo.svg)        | Public-domain simple geometry; trademarked                 |
| `waymo.svg`                             | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Waymo_logo.svg)         | Public-domain simple logo geometry; trademarked            |
| `xpeng.svg`                             | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:XPeng_logo.svg)         | Public-domain simple logo geometry; trademarked            |
| `zoox.svg`                              | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Zoox_logo.svg)          | Public-domain simple logo geometry; trademarked            |

Brand names and logos remain the property of their respective owners. Inclusion is for identification and interoperability and does not imply endorsement.
